# Chapter 6

## Exercises

### Q1

#### q1a

```{r}
data(sat, package = "faraway")
colnames(sat)
```

```{r}
lm_q1 <- lm(total ~ expend + salary + ratio + takers, data = sat)
summary(lm_q1)
```

```{r}
plot(
  x = fitted(lm_q1),
  y = residuals(lm_q1),
  xlab = "Fitted",
  ylab = "Residuals"
)
abline(h = 0)
```

```{r}
plot(
  x = fitted(lm_q1),
  y = sqrt(abs(residuals(lm_q1))),
  xlab = "Fitted",
  ylab = "Root Absolute Residuals"
)
```

```{r}
plot(x = lm_q1, which = 1)
```

The points appear evenly spread, with no clear pattern suggesting unequal variance or non-linearity.
